description.blurb: S/2007 S 9 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Norse group. It was discovered in 2007 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2007 S 9 is about 4 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 20.2 million km in 1078.07 days. It has an inclination of 159.3° to the ecliptic in a retrograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.360.
